verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The version-consistent ingestion and publication cluster is especially complete: source/ACL arrivals, normalization, hash classification, supersession and stale-record deletion, metadata-preserving chunking, rate-limited embedding with retry/dead-letter behavior, and gated three-store publication are all explicitly represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: No stated requirement is absent, partial, or contradicted.
verdict.coverage_summary: All 55 atomic requirements are fully and consistently represented across the PNG and canvas JSON. The board covers the complete ingestion-to-grounded-answer contract, permission filtering, low-confidence refusal, feedback-driven ingestion priorities, processing failures, publication failure semantics, and safe embedding-index rebuild and rollback behavior.
